review.notes: Reviewed the finite route, passport conditions, entry/transit exceptions and available evidence against the cited official sources. See docs/content-review-networks-2026-11-03.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

Only the documents and facts shown or obtainable through the offered checks are available. Unless expressly identified, the traveller has an ordinary passport, no additional citizenship, no destination residence, special passport, crew, e-Channel or other exemption. Short tourism only; no work. Routine entry permissions for an untested leg are not silently assumed when that leg is part of the puzzle.

Air Beluga training procedure (fictional carrier policy): complete the offered checks. Escalate a material eligibility, identity or transfer conflict that remains unresolved after those checks; deny a confirmed requirement failure once relevant obtainable alternatives are excluded. Unfamiliarity alone is insufficient. No live airline or government systems are called.

No Singapore visa or qualifying pass with a month of validity is held; UK departure checks are satisfied. The traveller has no Singapore visit planned.
clues: My Japan visa expires later this month. I am only changing gates in Singapore.

questions.label: Verify Singapore airside transfer
questions.response: The NRT boarding pass is issued and baggage is through-checked. The traveller remains in the international transit area; no Singapore immigration clearance is required.

rationale: Confirmed airside transit does not require Singapore entry eligibility or a VFTF qualifying pass. The unused Japanese visa covers onward entry. Do not impose the one-month VFTF condition on a passenger who never enters Singapore.
